$$= (ab + bc + ca) + 2(b\sqrt{ac} + c\sqrt{ab} + a\sqrt{bc})$$

$$E^2 = 1001 \left( \frac{1}{c} + \frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b} \right) + \frac{2002}{abc} (b\sqrt{ac} + c\sqrt{ab} + a\sqrt{bc})$$

$\sqrt{ab} = \sqrt{d^2 u^2 v^2} = d u v$ (integer)
$\sqrt{bc} = \sqrt{d^2 v^2 w^2} = d v w$ (integer)
And thus $R = b(duw) + c(duv) + a(dvw)$ is an integer.
